name: messaging-quest
description: A marketing colleague in your browser: finds the people asking for what you sell, drafts the reply three ways in your own voice, tracks who wrote back. Free models, your own Chrome, nothing hosted. You press Post; it never does.
author: Serhii Lahutin
//: Zero runtime dependencies, deliberately. The model layer is lib/llm.mjs — fetch, a JSON-schema check, and a tool loop — so `npm install` installs nothing, there is no supply chain to audit, and the whole tool runs on a bare Node 18. Before removing this property, read the header of lib/llm.mjs for what adding a framework back would actually buy.
